newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian shares close near day's highs on lira/ERM.
newsitem.headline: Italian shares close near day's highs on lira/ERM.

text.p: Italian stocks firmed in Friday afternoon trading to end just off their session highs on speculation the lira would be back in the European currency grid this weekend, traders said.
Prime Minister Romano Prodi said the lira's return was imminent after Italy lodged a formal request to be readmitted.

Bank of Italy governor Antonio Fazio confirmed from Frankfurt Italy had asked to be let back into the grid. European Union officials said the secretive EU monetary committee would meet on Saturday to discuss the Italian request.
The all-share Mibtel index ended 0.93 pct up at 10,543 after a 10,548 high and the Mib30 blue chip index closed up 1.02 pct at 15,788 after a high of 15,796.

The market was looking for confirmation of a fall in November CPI to 2.5 or 2.6 pct from an annual 3.0 pct rate in October when the last 4 of 10 sample Italian cities issued their CPI data at 1630 GMT after the Bourse close.
There was some speculation the Bank of Italy might take the opportunity to further cut its key interest rates.
Energy giant ENI ended 1.53 pct up at 7,875 lire, Fiat was 0.61 pct up at 4,640 and Olivetti rose 2.28 pct to 565. Telecoms were all higher, with state holding Stet up 2.88 pct at 6,475.
Shares in industrial group Montedison were off 0.64 pct at 1,082 after the U.S. SEC charged it with accounting fraud. Montedison said it would seek to solve the litigation promptly.
